name_reason: Compliant with the data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: data_fd2_ prefix, chapter domain, descriptor encodes the meaningful chapter ID (ch30 = chapter 30 good-ending, a real domain ID that must be preserved), the coordinate axis (pos_y), and the array data type (table). No Ghidra address residue (no _5233b / _2333b suffix). Name accurately reflects use as the per-char-slot Y world-tile coordinate table.
purpose: Chapter 30 (good ending) end-scene per-character Y world-tile coordinate table; one byte per char slot for slots 0..0x13 (20 slots).
logic_summary: Second of three adjacent 20-byte const tables (pos_x @ 0x52327, pos_y @ 0x5233B, facing @ 0x5234F) for the chapter-30 end scene. fd2_chapter_30_end copies it onto a 20-byte stack scratch buffer via a 5-dword MOVSD loop, then passes its address as arg2 (pos_y) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which indexes it by char slot to place the cast before the good-ending dialog/cutscene sequence.
element_semantics: element i = world-tile Y coordinate placed on runtime_char slot i (slots 0..0x13). Observed values 0x13,0x16,0x17,0x18,0x19 form an upward-stacked formation: {0x17,0x13,0x16,0x16,0x16,0x16,0x17,0x17,0x17,0x17,0x18,0x18,0x18,0x18,0x18,0x19,0x19,0x19,0x19,0x19}.
notes: Only 2 xrefs, both in fd2_chapter_30_end (READ @ 0x25785, DATA @ 0x25780); no game writer -> confirmed const read-only (is_const=true). Ghidra datatype byte[20], length 20, contents byte-identical to the const C definition in chend2.c lines 941-944. src comment block (chend2.c lines 928-936) already correctly and concisely documents all three ch30 tables collectively (FD2.LE addresses, 20-byte one-byte-per-slot, MOVSD x5 copy, facing slot-1 = 0x00), so no src edit was made (comment_verdict=keep). The data-address PLATE_COMMENT was empty (null), so a concise data plate mirroring the src conclusion was created. chend2.c was NOT modified; only the shard file is staged.
